apps.name: NicheLoader
apps.localizedDescription: NicheLoader is an on-device iOS signing app. Sign and install your own apps with your own certificate, inject tweaks, and manage your library - all for free.
apps.subtitle: On-device iOS signer by mintoo.

versions.localizedDescription:
NicheLoader 1.0.1 - first public release!

- Sign IPAs on-device with your own certificate (.p12 + .mobileprovision)
- Inject tweaks, dylibs and frameworks
- Built-in file manager, downloads and app library
- Purple accent color and fresh app icon
